text:
Chip Fields played **Rochelle**, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in season 4 episode 8 of *Good Times*, which aired November 17, 1976. [TVMaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields) both list her in that role for that episode. The "Lynnetta Gordon" role in my earlier answer is her later part, not this one.

CONFIDENCE: 85
